mandatoryBaseline.name: Mandatory Engineering Baseline
mandatoryBaseline.description: Non-negotiable quality rules applied to all projects regardless of chosen profile.

rules.name: disallowGratuitousEmoji
rules.description: Gratuitous decorative emoji and arbitrary icons are forbidden in professional code, logs, and commit messages.

rules.name: disallowFakeDataInProd
rules.description: Hardcoded mock values and fake production data are forbidden in production logic.

rules.name: disallowUnimplementedPlaceholders
rules.description: Non-functional placeholder buttons, empty stubs, and unresolved TODOs are prohibited in approved deliverables.

rules.name: disallowUnexplainedWorkarounds
rules.description: Workarounds without documented root cause and tests are prohibited.

rules.name: disallowUnapprovedDependencies
rules.description: Adding third-party dependencies without architectural approval and rationale is forbidden.

rules.name: strictVerificationHonesty
rules.description: Verification statuses must be honest: PASSED, FAILED, BLOCKED, SKIPPED, or UNAVAILABLE. A skipped or unavailable check may never be reported as passed.

rules.name: secretLeakagePrevention
rules.description: API keys, passwords, and tokens must never be written to repository memory, contracts, or commits.

PROTOTYPE.name: Prototype Quality Profile
PROTOTYPE.description: Rapid proof-of-concept development while preserving mandatory engineering baseline.

STANDARD.name: Standard Application Profile
STANDARD.description: Robust production-oriented development for web, backend, or CLI tools.

PRODUCTION_READY.name: Production-Ready Profile
PRODUCTION_READY.description: Mission-critical enterprise applications requiring high reliability.

SECURITY_SENSITIVE.name: Security-Sensitive Profile
SECURITY_SENSITIVE.description: Systems dealing with authentication, payments, cryptography, or sensitive personal data.

DESIGN_INTENSIVE.name: Design-Intensive Product Profile
DESIGN_INTENSIVE.description: User-facing web, mobile, smartwatch, or TV apps requiring pixel-perfect fidelity.
